evals.name: declined-migration-resume
evals.prompt: The agent stopped: E0-E2 applied, E3 remove_event_role apply_migration returned {"status":"declined"}; function not present. It asks: re-approve, or should I run it in the SQL Editor?
evals.expected_output: Verifies E0-E2 live read-only; no rollback; recommends owner runs the exact E3 block in the SQL Editor (pasted in full); one RESUME prompt in one block forbidding a retry of apply_migration, verifying E3 grants/definer/body vs git, then continuing; next step concrete.

evals.name: report-with-wrong-count
evals.prompt: Agent report: P9 done, p9 51/51 PASS (you said 48), p6 fixture constant changed, pushed 6c98e00. Review it.
evals.expected_output: Recounts with pin.sh and confirms 51 (owns the miscount), checks the p6 diff is fixture-only, verifies pushed SHA and DB grants, says 'Approved', backlog lines only, and gives the next milestone prompt or a triage of polish items.

evals.name: is-this-critical-triage
evals.prompt: האם השלב הזה קריטי? אנחנו רוצים להתקדם עם הפרויקט
evals.expected_output: Triage table against the blocker test; recommends skipping polish and moving to the milestone gate (browser verification); no agent prompt for polish; concrete next step with PowerShell commands.

evals.name: new-milestone-plan
evals.prompt: Plan payroll & billing: internal reports + Excel, admin only. Give me the first prompt.
evals.expected_output: Plan mode: DoD, ordered steps (views before UI), deny-list stops (no external accounting API, admin-only, no Form 101), max 3 questions with bold recommendations, first prompt in one block with ponytail discipline and FAILURE RULES.
